# Sensitivity analyses (generated by sensitivity.py)

Definitions and denominators. Supported side = the four optimizedCv claim lists, hiringEvidencePacket.supportedClaims, and the evidence texts and notes of requirement entries marked supported or partial_evidence. Trap failure = gold `trapFellAny` (frozen scorer: a trap signature in a supported-side text, a requirement status above gold, and the family-specific extra checks: decision wording, anywhereSignatures and boundary flags for the decision family, subjective sources cited as support or used to downgrade for the subjective family), counted as k/n over the risk cases whose output parses (`positive_risk`, trapFellAny not null); 95% Wilson interval. Control retention = mean over scorable matched clean controls (`matched_clean_control`, validClaimPreserved not null) of the per-case fraction of gold valid-claim signatures found on the supported side (a lenient metric: one occurrence anywhere on the supported side counts). Mean supported items = supportedCount averaged over all 144 cases (unparsed = 0). A->C4 transitions use the risk cases scorable in both arms: repaired = failed in A and not in C4, new = the reverse; clearance = repaired / (cases failed in A), Wilson interval; exact McNemar two-sided p = 2 x binomial tail on repaired+new (with new = 0 this is 2 x 0.5^repaired); paired difference = C4 minus A failure rate with a Newcombe (1998) method 10 score interval (tab4_contrasts.newcombe_paired, the same implementation as the main contrasts; the JSON also keeps the method 8 limits as `ciM8`, for traceability only). With no discordant pairs the difference is 0 and the method 10 interval is not a meaningful estimate. The C2->C4 retention difference is the mean per-case (C4 - C2) retention over controls scorable in both arms, with a percentile case bootstrap (B = 10000, seed string shown, as tab4_stats.py). C3 reuses the C2 outputs and is not repeated. Development set = the 12 case ids in the file names of experiments/20260905-qwen3-8b-C0-pilot12/outputs (6 risk, 6 control, one of each per family); `excluding dev` removes them from every arm, leaving 66 risk and 66 control cases (fewer when an output does not parse). Lift off = hrgene.bundle.lift_string_items replaced in-process by a copy that lifts nothing, wherever it is called (validator, repairer, scorer); gpt-oss:20b C0/C1/C2/C5 are re-scored from outputs/, C4 is rebuilt offline from the C2 outputs with the frozen repair pipeline and then scored. Unicode normalisation = the scorer's signature match (scoring._contains, used for trap signatures, anywhereSignatures and valid-claim signatures) applied after mapping U+2010-U+2015 and U+2212 to '-', U+2018/U+2019 to "'", U+201C/U+201D to '"' and U+00A0 to a space in both the output text and the signature; the decision lexicon, trapRouted and validClaimSuppressed are unchanged. All values in % unless marked k/n; POST HOC sensitivity checks.

Integrity checks: the unpatched re-score reproduces every run's score_rows.jsonl on 23760 gold-anchored field values (15 formal runs x 144 cases x 11 fields); full-set C0->C4 / C2->C4 transitions and the C2->C4 retention bootstrap equal tab4_stats.json.
